## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

Shop configuration, read by nearly every module and depending on none.

The cache is shared across processes through `app_preferences.updated_at`, and
two invariants keep it honest. The watermark must never be newer than the
values it describes, and a write must reload rather than patch its own keys in.
Breaking either lets a reader believe it is current while serving stale values,
which previously disabled sign-in and payment methods at random.

Defaults are deliberately restrictive: an absent row means a payment or sign-in
method is *off*. A bug that loses the cache must fail closed, not open.

<!-- invariants:end -->
